topic.title: Review Task Roles
topic.shortdesc: Review task roles determine how the task's collaborators participate in the review process.

body.p: There are two possible review task roles, Reviewer and Owner:

section.title: Reviewer
section.p: Reviewer is the default role assigned to users participating in a review task.
Users with this role are responsible for providing feedback on the content under review.

li.p: Read the documents included in the review.
Participate in discussions related to the review.

section.p: This role is typically assigned to Subject-Matter Experts (SMEs) or other contributors who are asked to review the task content.

section.title: Owner
section.p: Owner is the role assigned to the user who created the review task or to users that were granted this role by another task owner.

li.p: Manage access to the review task.
Assign review task roles to other users.
Control the workflow of the review task.
Integrate the accepted changes from the review task into the original content repository.
